overall_assessment: Section extraction for inn works well in this packet: learning outcomes are complete, arbeidskrav/obligatoriske aktiviteter are correctly filed as coursework_requirements, 'Ingen' prerequisites and the 'Ingen pensumliste' placeholder are dropped, and no section is missing or truncated. The pre-pass 'leak->' flags are false alarms (in-text words like 'vurderingsformer', 'Arbeidsmåter'). Only minor noise remains: the flattened exam-table header in assessment, lost Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse sub-headings, and a generic Praksis paragraph appended to teaching_methods.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer Praksis Bestått - Ikke bestått Individuell 100%
findings.description: Every assessment section begins with the flattened exam-logistics table (fixed header row 'Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer' followed by a run-together data row with grade scale, duration, aids, share). This is template boilerplate and logistics, not narrative assessment content; the table cells are unparseable once flattened. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag is therefore a real (if benign) problem: the section is correct but not clean.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The HTML table is flattened to one line by text extraction and .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R does not strip the fixed header prefix or the table row.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), for assessment remove the line starting with 'Vurderingsordning Karakterskala Gruppe/individuell Varighet Hjelpemidler Andel Kommentarer' (the whole flattened table line), or alternatively keep only the narrative lines after it.

findings.evidence: kan anvende teori og forskning i eget arbeid kan anvende pedagogisk teori og kunnskap om mangfold og elevenes forutsetninger
findings.description: Content is complete, but the sub-headings Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse are stripped, leaving a bare repeated 'Studenten' line (or, where the source lacks 'Studenten', no separator at all) between the three groups. The knowledge/skills/general-competence structure is lost; in inn_2MPRA171S-5-1_2022_spring_1 a duplicated source heading leaves one stray 'Ferdigheter' line, so the result is also inconsistent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Sub-headings are consumed as absorbed headings in R/extract_sections.R without being emitted into the text.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse (and Kunnskapsmål/Ferdighetsmål) as lines inside learning_outcomes rather than dropping them, or replace them with a consistent marker; at minimum remove stray duplicates.

findings.evidence: Praksisstudiet er en integrert del av fagene som inngår i utdanningen. Alle fag i utdanningen har sammen med praksisstudiet ansvar for at studentene utvikler identitet som lærer.
findings.description: The 'Praksis' sub-heading (under Arbeids- og undervisningsformer) maps to nothing, so its generic boilerplate paragraph about practice studies is appended to teaching_methods together with the heading word 'Praksis'. The text is identical across many courses and is not course-specific teaching-method content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Praksis' heading has no pattern in R/section_heading_map.R so text continues the previous section (teaching_methods).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern for a standalone 'Praksis' heading in R/section_heading_map.R that maps to a dropped/ignored section (or strip the boilerplate paragraph 'Praksisstudiet er en integrert del av fagene...' in .clean_sections()). Keep it in teaching_methods only if course-specific practice organisation is wanted.
